name: claude-mods
description: Unofficial mods for the Claude Code desktop app, made by @claudemod (not affiliated with Anthropic)

plugins.name: xp-bar
plugins.description: A Minecraft-style XP bar above the prompt: your usage limit, roughly how many tokens that is, and when it refills

plugins.name: craft-rush
plugins.description: A crafting mini-game for the wait: random inventory, craft as much as you can before time runs out. Start it with /craft
